used.how: the test switches DECODER_SKIP in-process through model.use_decoder_skip (a model attribute the adapter reads), not through settings, since settings freeze at load
test_contract judges the cap path at cap via the FIX.26 handoff golden; no new handoff point was needed: the prefix-hit checks use rows the s10240 golden already holds
decode's stop P is computed with KV_BLOCK_SIZE as tt-d-gen will; PREFILL_END=cap then gives run_end == P for every P (multiple of 64)
the shifted write at global_write_start goes through TtServedRows' any-start path (_region for the bfp8 key copy), whose re-rounding of old rows is an identity
the gated write never takes the P.11 pack path (start % S == 0 only); it uses the gathered path, the same bytes
AttnTable.rows_copy asserts a partial slice (a full-range slice would alias the table buffer it then restores into)
every device run over ~9 min started through devjob, waited in short calls
the new test reads snapshot configs through TableReader.records (its 4 records) and compares them after the request, as tt-d-gen ships them
